programme.desc: A smooth-talking man gets an opportunity to realise his goal of becoming a Casanova and seizes it. Soon, he finds himself dating three air hostesses, roaming around in cars and enjoying the good life.

programme.title: Thaskara Lahala
programme.desc: Three inseparable friends devise an ingenious ploy to fund a destitute woman's marriage. However, destiny plays a cruel game after an unscrupulous individual steal their hard-earned funds.

programme.title: Nokketha Doorathu Kannum Nattu
programme.desc: Kunjoonjamma is an elderly woman who lives alone in a village. Her life changes when a girl named Girly claims that she is her granddaughter and comes to live with her.

programme.title: Kilichundan Mambazham
programme.desc: Moidukutty's new and third wife, Amina, is secretly in love with a bangle seller.

programme.title: Punjabi House
programme.desc: A fisherman saves a suicidal Unni, only to sell him to a Punjabi moneylender in Kerala. Unni is then forced to pose as a man with hearing and speech impairment, resulting in hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Neyyattinkara Gopante Aaraattu
programme.desc: An affluent man is called upon to hand over his vast plot of land to the government. However, situations take a turn when he brings the influential Neyyattinkara Gopan into the picture.

programme.title: Lucky Bhaskar
programme.desc: A struggling bank teller takes a chance on a shady investment scheme with an unproven partner. Later, as his fortunes rise, so does his ego, driving him to take on increasingly reckless risks.

programme.title: RDX
programme.desc: Robert, Dony and Xavier grow up together while honing their fighting skills. However, after an incident separates them for several years, an attack on their family reunites the three friends.

programme.title: Aravindante Athidhikal
programme.desc: After being forsaken by his mother in a temple, Aravindan, a five-year-old boy, is taken in by a hotelier. Against all odds, Aravindan clings to the hope of reuniting with his mother.

programme.title: Kanakam Kaamini Kalaham
programme.desc: As a last-ditch effort to save his marriage, Pavithran gifts Haripriya a gold necklace. Mayhem ensues when the jewellery gets stolen and a set of strangers gets invested in finding the culprit.

programme.title: Hailesa
programme.desc: Unnikrishnan is forced to move to the city after he beats up some thugs for his foster family. In the city, he starts working for Ganapathy Iyer, a rich man who is seeking his long-lost lover.

programme.title: Ambili
programme.desc: Ambili, a naive and wide-eyed young man, is adored by everyone for his quirky traits. He hopes to marry his childhood love, Tina, and restore the lost bond with his friend and Tina's brother, Bobby.

programme.title: Action Hero Biju
programme.desc: Biju Poulose leaves his teaching job to pursue his dream of serving in the police force. Posted as the sub-inspector in Cochin, he has to handle notorious criminals who indulge in unlawful activities.

programme.title: Ronth
programme.desc: A senior cop and a new recruit are forced to work together through a tense night shift, confronting danger and personal dilemmas that reveal deep cracks in the system.

programme.title: Yodha
programme.desc: A man is told he is the saviour destined to rescue a precious Nepalese Buddhist monk from black magic practitioners. The chief black magician wishes to sacrifice the lama to attain power.

programme.title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
programme.desc: Rocky, a young man, seeks power and wealth in order to fulfil a promise to his dying mother. His quest takes him to Mumbai, where he gets involved with the notorious gold mafia.

programme.title: Padakkalam
